system.description:
This beautiful harmony can be sung in accompaniment to any other spell-song. The Song of Songs may help a Elven spell song as if it were a related skill. Song of Songs may not help skill-songs.

Obstacle: See Description. If an obstacle is needed for Song of Songs, use the time and obstacles of the skill being helped. The Song of Songs may be used to cause wonderment like other spell songs at Ob 2.

Actions: 25 for the purpose of causing wonderment

Elven spell song: counts as a sorcerous skill for practice and learning; tests are always open-ended (natural magic); no tools, no FoRKs; causes wonderment. Root is Will unless otherwise noted.

Restrictions: Elves only

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 150
